exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ход — motion, movement, travel, progress, locomotion, headway; ходи́ть — to go, to walk; необходи́мость — necessity, need; необходи́мый — indispensable.
